_comment: MOCK MANIFEST FOR LOCAL DEVELOPMENT ONLY. These tool names, descriptions and parameter schemas are hand-written and FICTIONAL. They do not describe the real GitHub or Slack MCP servers and must not be presented as such. This file exists for two reasons: (1) to demonstrate multi-server routing via ToolRouter.from_manifests(), which is the case the project is really aimed at, and (2) to exercise a DIFFERENT manifest SHAPE from swiggy_manifest.json -- a flat top-level 'tools' array with a per-tool 'server' field and 'inputSchema' instead of 'parameters' -- proving the parser is genuinely generic rather than fitted to one layout.
name: devtools-mock

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search code across repositories by keyword, language or path.
examples: find where the retry logic is defined
search for usages of parse_manifest in the backend repo

tools.name: open_pull_request
tools.description: Open a new pull request from a head branch into a base branch.
examples: raise a PR from my feature branch into main
open a draft pull request for the parser rewrite

tools.name: review_pull_request
tools.description: Submit a review on an existing pull request, approving or requesting changes.
examples: request changes on the migration PR

tools.name: list_open_issues
tools.description: List open issues in a repository, filtered by label or assignee.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: File a new issue in a repository with a title, body and labels.
examples: file a bug about the flaky test
open an issue to track the reranker work

tools.name: trigger_workflow_run
tools.description: Trigger a CI workflow run on a given branch or commit.
examples: re-run the test suite on main

tools.name: post_channel_message
tools.description: Post a message to a Slack channel.
examples: tell the team the deploy is done

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search past Slack messages by keyword, channel or author.
examples: what did we decide about the vector store
find the thread where the outage was discussed

tools.name: schedule_reminder
tools.description: Schedule a reminder for a user or channel at a future time.
examples: remind me to review the PR tomorrow morning

tools.name: set_user_status
tools.description: Set the current user's Slack status text, emoji and expiry.

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp when the status clears.

examples: set my status to in a meeting until 3pm
